instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. At a campsite with a blue tent and green trees, the woman with curly brown hair (R1) in a beige top stands on the left, hugging the bearded man in the navy shirt (R2) on the right. She looks up affectionately into his eyes, her arms wrapped around his waist. The bearded man (R2), wearing a green plaid scarf and plaid pants, looks down at her with a gentle smile, holding her close. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, creating a warm and intimate atmosphere.
